implementerProof.how: Round six follows the forward merge c9f4cb6e, which the reviewer's approval at 683c93b6 preceded. I computed the unchanged-diff fingerprint at the head my last E2E line names (97c793359d3a → 80def57ef7f08db380f243b87aa3e2717f5d7c0d075921191e39753a3b9f5e5d) and at this head (d914571538ed → 62d7c68b11fa55f14c48065f9099e53e752b762d9d8c00e8bd514f07908a8e17): different, so this is a full test round rather than a bare-gate re-check. Reading the two fingerprint diffs against each other shows the whole of that difference: the pull request's own lines moved in exactly two places, both prose — the `/ws/doc/{room}` row of cmd/dispatch/README.md, where main rewrote the row this branch also rewrites and the merge keeps both sides (this branch's `user` and its sentence that the room takes a person's cookie and no bearer, on top of main's new text), and a code comment that now names migration 0021's expiry index rather than 0020's, which is the reviewer's own commit 6c1023be. No executable line of the branch's own diff changed. I ran the full battery anyway, as the skill requires after any forward merge, on a live pair rebuilt at this head and driven by the second DPoP/RFC 8693 client written from the RFCs with the Go standard library alone: all three of the implementer's proofs for this round hold, and every acceptance line of rounds one to five repeats.
